name: Hidden Panic Room
description: A low-ceilinged attic room, clearly retrofitted for emergencies. The walls are lined with padded fabric, and a single dim bulb casts a warm glow. The air is surprisingly fresh, vented from somewhere unseen. The space smells faintly of old wool blankets and melted candle wax. A small cot, a lantern, and a crate of bottled water sit in the corner.

items.name: Crossbow
items.description: A compact crossbow, meticulously maintained and loaded with a single bolt. The wood is darkened with age, but the string is taut and the mechanism is clean. It looks effective, if only you had a clear shot.

items.name: Rations of Dried Meat
items.description: A strip of tough, salted meat. It's edible, if not exactly gourmet.

items.name: Bundle of Candles
items.description: Three beeswax candles, tightly bound with a thin string. They exude a faint honey scent.

items.name: Half-Full Waterskin
items.description: A leather waterskin, about half full of fresh water.
